description: This file contains Redux Saga generator functions for handling side effects such as API calls, user authentication, fetching notes, categories, settings, and synchronizing data in a note-taking application. It also defines the root saga that combines multiple watchers.

methods.name: loginUser
methods.description: Generator function to handle user login, fetching user data from API or demo mode.

methods.name: logoutUser
methods.description: Generator function to handle user logout, removing auth cookies or tokens.

methods.name: fetchNotes
methods.description: Generator function to fetch notes data from API or demo mode, then dispatch success or error actions.

methods.name: fetchCategories
methods.description: Generator function to fetch categories data from API or demo mode, then dispatch success or error actions.

methods.name: fetchSettings
methods.description: Generator function to fetch user settings from API and dispatch success or error actions.

methods.name: syncData
methods.description: Generator function to synchronize data with API or demo mode, then dispatch success or error actions.

methods.name: syncSettings
methods.description: Generator function to save current settings.

methods.name: rootSaga
methods.description: Main saga that watches for specific actions and triggers corresponding worker sagas.
